node.statement: All scalar prerequisite errors are at most t_3. Namely epsilon_U,epsilon_V<=W.L*epsilon<=t_3; d_U<=c0*epsilon_U<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3 and similarly for d_V; each displayed reset unit norm is <=c0*epsilon_U or <=c0*epsilon_V and hence <=t_3; epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=t_3; and the direct-envelope bounds L^0*epsilon and c0*epsilon, together with the supplied global unit error ||w(I)-I_A||<=c0*epsilon, are <=t_3. This uses only c0>=0, epsilon>=0, W.L>=L^0>=1, and W.K3>=max{1,W.L,c0*W.L}; no assumption c0>=1 is used.
